description: This file contains code for generating CUDA and CPU implementations of universal functions (ufuncs) in PyTorch, including classes for functor signatures, functions for computing dispatch code, and code generation for different backends.

classes.name: UfunctorSignature
classes.description: Represents functors for implementing CUDA ufuncs, including methods for generating code for arguments, fields, constructor, and operator() declaration.

classes.name: UfuncSignature
classes.description: Represents a ufunc's signature, including methods for generating argument list and call expression.

classes.name: BinaryScalarSpecializationConfig
classes.description: Configuration for binary scalar specialization, including scalar index, constructor tensor name, and ufunc key.

classes.name: StubSignature
classes.description: Represents the signature of a stub function for CPU ufunc dispatch, including methods for generating function declarations and calls.

methods.name: arguments
methods.description: Returns the arguments for the functor or ufunc, depending on the class.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Returns the list of fields for the functor, with renamed identifiers.

methods.name: returns_type
methods.description: Returns the return type of the functor.

methods.name: decl_fields
methods.description: Generates the C++ declaration string for the functor's fields.

methods.name: inline_defn_ctor
methods.description: Generates the inline constructor definition for the functor.

methods.name: decl_apply
methods.description: Generates the declaration string for the functor's operator() method.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Generates the call expression for the ufunc with given context.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the C++ type string for the ufunc signature.

methods.name: arguments
methods.description: Returns the list of arguments for the ufunc.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Generates the call expression for the ufunc with given context.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Property returning the name of the stub or kernel.

methods.name: kernel_name
methods.description: Property returning the kernel function name.

methods.name: type_name
methods.description: Property returning the type alias name.

methods.name: arguments
methods.description: Returns the list of arguments for the stub.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the C++ type string for the stub.

methods.name: dispatch_decl
methods.description: Returns the dispatch declaration string.

methods.name: dispatch_defn
methods.description: Returns the dispatch definition string.

methods.name: kernel_defn
methods.description: Returns the kernel function declaration string.

methods.name: type_defn
methods.description: Returns the type alias definition string.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Generates the function call string for the stub.

methods.name: direct_call
methods.description: Generates the direct kernel call string for CUDA.

methods.name: compute_ufunc_cpu
methods.description: Generates CPU dispatch code for a given native function group.

methods.name: compute_ufunc_cpu_dtype_body
methods.description: Generates the body of the CPU dtype-specific implementation.

methods.name: compute_ufunc_cpu_kernel
methods.description: Generates the CPU kernel implementation code.

methods.name: compute_ufunc_cuda
methods.description: Generates CUDA dispatch code for a given native function group.

methods.name: compute_ufunc_cuda_dtype_body
methods.description: Generates the body of the CUDA dtype-specific implementation.
